messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Subject: Follow-up: GDPR / DPA & SCC choices (post-call recap)

Hi Alex / Sofia —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the procurement side: 

1) Scope & roles: AcmeHealth indicated the intent to treat Redwood as a processor for the use case (user-facing search and summarized notes). Please confirm if that remains correct for legal.
2) DPA: I'm attaching our standard DPA (Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf) — this covers data processing terms and the security safeguards. If you have preferred edits, flag them and we can loop legal.
3) SCCs: Per the call, you wanted options for SCC modules; I attached a short SCC_Comparison_Table.xlsx that maps Module 1 vs Module 2/3 applicability given transfer scenarios. For AcmeHealth's EU customers we usually recommend the Module 2 addendum when processing limited customer-identifiable data; happy to discuss specifics.
4) SOC 2 / HIPAA: you asked about SOC 2 coverage and any HIPAA controls. Marissa (CC) will share the SOC 2 scope and a brief note on HIPAA-readiness.
5) Vendor questionnaire: if you want, send over your vendor security questionnaire and we'll start populating — I can assign the right folks.

Next steps proposed:
- You confirm controller/processor stance for legal (ideally by EOD Thu)
- I upload the DPA & SCC options; Marissa to send SOC 2 scope
- If procurement wants a formal timeline, we can set a review call next week to walk the redlines (suggest Tue 6/15 10am PT)

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf (pdf), SCC_Comparison_Table.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor

Redwood Inference

Thanks Neha — very helpful recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Controller/Processor: Our legal team is leaning toward labeling AcmeHealth as controller and Redwood as processor for this integration, but they want to confirm a few data flow diagrams first. I should have a definitive answer by Monday.
- SOC 2: Can you confirm whether SOC 2 Type II is current and whether the scope includes access controls and change management for the inference runtime? We need that for our security team.
- HIPAA: We are assessing PHI risk for one pilot customer; can you confirm whether Redwood will sign a BAAs for covered PHI use cases?

Also happy to share our vendor security questionnaire — attaching the blank PDF. If you can get initial responses by EOD Tue that would be great.

Regards,
Alex
Sr. IT Security Manager, AcmeHealth
alex.jones@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>; Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-13T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: GDPR / DPA & SCC choices (post-call recap)

Hi Alex —

Following up on SOC 2 and HIPAA questions: 
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report current through March 2027. The scope includes logical access controls, change management, incident response, and data encryption-in-transit and at-rest for the inference platform. I can share the SOC 2 summary and our auditor contact under an NDA.
- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood does offer BAAs for customers with covered PHI workflows — we have an established BAA addendum we can attach for review. Please note that the BAA requires mutually agreed scoping of PHI flows and any downstream subprocessors that will handle PHI.

Regarding SCC module selection & controller/processor alignment: based on the brief flow you described, treating AcmeHealth as controller and Redwood as processor is consistent with our standard posture. For transfers we typically include the EU Commission SCCs as an addendum; the Comparison table I included to Neha maps common scenarios. If you require Module 2 vs Module 3 specifics, please share the primary transfer flows and we'll advise.

I started populating your Vendor Security Questionnaire and attached initial answers for sections 1-4; items needing procurement/legal input are flagged in yellow. I can continue and loop in Rishi for any infra-level technical deep dives.

Attachments: SOC2_Summary_2027.pdf (pdf, stub), Redwood_BAA_Addendum.pdf (pdf), Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Acme_filled.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the filled questionnaire — that helps a lot. A few items: 

- We confirmed controller/processor: AcmeHealth will be controller; Redwood will be processor. Legal will start redlining the DPA and expected SCC addendum.
- SOC2: Procurement would like a copy of the SOC2 report under NDA. We can share an NDA link, or you can send via your secure drive link.
- BAA: We are evaluating PHI scope for the pilot. For now, please keep the BAA template handy; we may request it once scope is finalized.

Plan: Our legal/procurement team will send DPA redlines via DocuSign link this week. Can we aim to have an initial redline review call on Tue 6/22 at 10am ET? If that works, I will send a calendar invite.

Thanks — will follow up with the DocuSign when ready.
